name: VIVIM OS Capability Taxonomy
status: CANDIDATE — first pass, owner-directed 2026-10-05. Capability ids are platform-neutral and human-friendly; realizations are per-platform implementations. Not frozen.
idGrammar: <domain>.<object>.<action> — lowercase, '.'-separated, hyphenated words; the op routed by Ω is os.<r|m|x>.<capability-id>@1 where the letter is the risk class (r=READ, m=MUTATION, x=EXTERNAL_MUTATION).

present.meaning: Opens a window, app, panel or setting page for the user; no setting changes by itself.

adjust.meaning: Changes a reversible setting or UI state (volume, brightness, window layout).

create.meaning: Creates new user content (folder, file, screenshot, shortcut).

modify.meaning: Renames or relocates existing content; reversible by the inverse capability.

session-pause.meaning: Pauses the session without closing apps (lock, sleep, hibernate).

destroy.meaning: Removes content, data or a configuration; may be unrecoverable or lose unsaved work.

session-end.meaning: Ends the session or powers the device down; open apps close.

system.meaning: Installs/updates software or changes machine-wide configuration.

network.meaning: Sends a request or data off the machine (web, catalogs, IP lookup).

reveal.meaning: Surfaces sensitive information (passwords, clipboard) into VIVIM; consent-gated though nothing is changed.

portability.universal: Every mainstream desktop OS has an equivalent
portability.platform-specific: Meaningful mainly on one OS family

privacy.sensitive: Surfaces secrets or potentially secret data

paramTypes.enum: One of the listed values (platform values via realization paramMap)
paramTypes.path: File/folder path; absolute, or '~\\…' relative to the user's home

strategies.run: Run a console program and capture its output and exit code
strategies.powershell: Run a PowerShell body; its output is the result
strategies.keys: Synthesize a keyboard shortcut (targets the foreground window unless noted)
strategies.builtin-map: Dispatch to a nested realization chosen by an enum parameter

fidelity.approximate: Performs a close equivalent (e.g. a toggle where 'set' was asked); result must be checked
fidelity.handoff: Opens the right place for the user to finish; VIVIM does not claim the change happened

evidence.authored: Written from platform documentation/knowledge; not yet executed by VIVIM
evidence.verified-local: Executed by VIVIM on a real machine with recorded result
